sourceChecks.locator: National Institute of Korean Language report, PDF pp. 104–105, lines 2587–2601: conversational-corpus conventions and recorded uses of -거든, -더니; it is usage documentation, not a full grammar for every ending.
sourceChecks.finding: El corpus oficial documenta usos conversacionales y ejemplos puntuales de -거든/-더니; no valida todos los juicios pragmáticos ni ejemplos de la ficha.

sourceChecks.locator: KCI metadata/abstract, lines 25–49 and APA export lines 98–124: Lee (2020), 담화와 인지, 27(4), 53–71, DOI 10.15718/discog.2020.27.4.53; Sejong Corpus analysis of Korean second-person markers, context-sensitive choice, spontaneous spoken 당신 effects.
sourceChecks.finding: Supports context-dependent use of 당신 and rejects a simple universal second-person equivalent; abstract identifies mitigation of criticism and topic-shift attention. It does not support every Spanish translation or blanket prohibition.

assessEntry: not passed; claim-level source coverage incomplete
